title: Contact and Debt
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Ivo Marchetti, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
